reading: The sketch is a Kanban/task board: a 56px white top nav bar with left-aligned 'Sprint 42' label, search field, and filter links (All selected, Mine, Bugs, Blocked); four column header lines (To do/5, In progress/4·3 in red, Review/2, Done/7); then two dashed-divider swimlanes labeled 'WEB APP' and 'MOBILE', each containing colored, tagged task cards (some with progress bars, some faded/struck-through as done) with colored avatar dots, per the typed notes.
